svg.title: Cat face in four steps, on medium skin. 1: dab two round white puffs on the upper lip, one each side of the center. 2: a black nose on the tip of the nose and a line down the middle to the lip. 3: small black dots on the puffs and three whiskers on each side, painted as pressure strokes flicked outward. Done: little fur flicks above the brows, a white shine on the nose and pink cheeks.
